blocks.heading: Registration Status State
rows: State your qualification and registration honestly.
Required to practise as a pharmacist.
Explain how you simplify a prescription.
A dispensing or lab practical record
Shows exposure to manufacturing or quality.

blocks.heading: Weak Lines in a Pharmacy Interview
rows: I could not get medicine, so pharmacy.
Say what drew you to pharmacy.
I want to open a medical shop.
Say you will gain experience and follow licence rules first.
Name a setting and a skill.

blocks.heading: Growth and AI Behind a Pharmacy Answer
Practice Rounds Before the Interview
rows: A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing.
Say it aloud under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on rules.
